claim: Across multiple preregistered, mutually shared-code-disjoint public Honduras ONCAE-SEFIN cohorts from 2023-2025, after exact contract/project-code blocking and compatible supplier identity, a fixed fail-closed documentary policy for the maximum claim CONTRACTOR_PAYMENT reduces unsupported payment attribution relative to CODE+SUPPLIER without reducing recovery of supported payments, while preserving one-to-many contract-payment cardinality; the result is evaluated with strong baselines, monetary amount at risk, permutation controls, an independent policy implementation, and clean public reconstruction.
exclusive_predictions: CODE+SUPPLIER still overpromotes auxiliary, accounting-only, payee-authority-ambiguous, or object-conflicting events.
The fixed documentary policy strictly reduces unsupported promotions without reducing supported-payment recovery.
Rotating candidate-specific financial evidence materially worsens safety or supported-payment recovery.
The safety-recovery result persists on cohorts excluding every previously evaluated shared code.
A clean reconstruction from the six official packages reproduces cohort identities, labels, policy decisions, and metrics.
An independent implementation of the policy reproduces every decision and reason.
falsifiers: Any unsupported promotion by the fixed policy on a sealed replication cohort.
Any loss of supported-payment recovery relative to CODE+SUPPLIER.
Failure on a cohort that excludes all previously evaluated shared codes.
A permutation control that is not worse than candidate-specific evidence.
A clean replay that changes the frozen cohort, labels, decisions, or metrics.
A primary source predating the search cut that reports the same bounded result with equivalent gates.
An independent implementation that disagrees with the policy on any candidate.

prior_art_boundary.interpretation: No exact hit in searched corpora is not proof of global novelty.
absorbed_components: public payment ingestion and record linkage
contract-payment reconciliation and accounts-payable exception handling
